subject: POC qualification & ownership checklist
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laurent Dubois <laurent.dubois@bluecove.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T16:12:00+02:00
Subject: POC qualification & ownership checklist

Hi Laurent —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth before we kick off a short POC:  

Summary of scope (agreed on call)
- Ingest: BlueCove will provide a 1-week batch of telemetry + one low-latency stream from their edge site (Site-7) for model inference.
- Use case: anomaly detection + ranked incident summaries for triage.
- Success metric: 70% reduction in mean time to detect (MTTD) for top-10 incident classes, and precision >= 0.75 on triage label.

Proposed POC timeline (target)
- Week 1 (May 10) — Infra onboarding & network test (VPN + sample stream)
- Week 2 — Model baseline runs, prompt tuning, and initial evals
- Week 3 — Customer validation, runbook handover, and metrics review

Ownership (first pass RACI) — please confirm who on your side owns each area; on our side I’ve proposed owners below.
- Infra (customer network/edge): R = BlueCove (Laurent/Site-7 ops), A = BlueCove (Sofia Marin for procurement sign-off), C = Redwood infra (Monica Patel), I = Redwood sales (me).
- Integration (stream ingestion, schema): R = BlueCove eng, A = BlueCove eng, C = Redwood engineering (Marissa Cole), I = Redwood solutions (Aditya Rao).
- Security & compliance: R = BlueCove security, C = Redwood security (Monica), A = BlueCove (procurement sign-off).
- Success criteria & evaluation: R = BlueCove product, C = Redwood applied ML (Marissa), A = Redwood (me for final acceptance).

Attachments:
- I’m attaching a short POC-success-criteria.xlsx with the metrics we discussed and a suggested reporting cadence.

Immediate asks (can you):
1) Confirm infra owner for Site-7 and send a network contact for our infra team.
2) Share any firewall/egress constraints or allowlist requirements.
3) Confirm procurement timeline for a short-term connectivity agreement (SLA-lite).

If that looks right I’ll circulate an internal RACI + a one-page activation checklist to expedite onboarding.

Thanks — talk soon.

--
Karthik Iyer

Date: 2027-05-03T09:08:00+02:00
Subject: Re: POC qualification & ownership checklist

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear recap. A couple points from our side:  

- Confirmed: Site-7 ops (Marcel Moreau) will be the infra owner for the edge stream. I’ll intro Marcel to Monica for the network handshake.
- Firewall: We allow outbound TLS on 443 to specific egress ranges; I’ll attach our network diagram.
- Procurement: Sofia Marin (cc’d) handles short-term contracts; she estimates ~7 business days to approve a connectivity addendum if scope is clear.

One ask: on the success criteria sheet could you add an expected sample size for the evaluation (we typically want at least 1,000 labeled incidents across the pilot window)?

I’ve attached: bluecove-network-diagram.png and copied Marcel and Sofia on this thread.

Best,
Laurent

BlueCove Energy

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-04T11:22:00+02:00
Subject: Re: POC qualification & ownership checklist

Looping internal owners — quick operational checklist and who will own the tasks on our side so we can respond to BlueCove tomorrow:  

1) Network onboarding (Monica) — schedule VPN test with Site-7 next Tue (May 11). Need Marcel’s IP ranges and any proxy details.
2) Ingestion schema & adapter (Marissa) — review their sample batch and confirm column mapping; target PR for adapter code by May 14.
3) Evaluation harness & metrics (Aditya) — add sample-size row to the workbook (target >=1,000 labeled incidents) and wire up basic dashboard in our sandbox.
4) Procurement/commercial (Karthik) — circulate short connectivity addendum + cost estimate; coordinate with Sofia for timeline.

Notes on risk and mitigation:
- Risk: insufficient labeled incidents. Mitigation: run synthetic labeling and a small human-in-the-loop review to bootstrap.
- Risk: network egress approval delay. Mitigation: ask for ephemeral S3 staging (customer-managed) as fallback.

I’ll prepare a concise RACI table and an activation checklist we can send BlueCove. Any objections to the owners above?

Thanks — I’ll drop the RACI in Drive and share the link in the next note.

--
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
